title: Inquest called in 2010 police cell death
article: A public inquest into the death of Walter Clinton McKenzie has been scheduled for March 3 to 7 in La Ronge.
McKenzie, 32, was found unresponsive in his cell at the La Ronge RCMP detachment on Sept. 7, 2010, and was taken to the Royal University Hospital in Saskatoon, where he died the following day.
Coroner Robert Kennedy of Saskatoon will preside at the inquest.
